components.name: STM32G474
components.description: Acquires sensor measurements, maintains their validity state, writes the aircraft log and prepares the live telemetry packet.

components.name: NEO-M9N GNSS
components.description: Provides position, velocity and GPS time. Its time-pulse output gives the logger a timing reference.

components.name: BNO085 IMU
components.description: Measures acceleration, angular velocity and orientation for the flight record.

components.name: BME280 barometer
components.description: Measures pressure and temperature, including the pressure input used to estimate barometric altitude.

components.name: HX711 strain interface
components.description: Digitises the strain-gauge bridge input for structural or load measurements.

components.name: microSD socket
components.description: Stores the aircraft's binary flight record, including sensor validity, estimator output and event markers.

components.name: SX1262 LoRa module
components.description: Sends the live telemetry subset to the ground station and receives logging, marker and radio-profile commands.

components.name: GNSS and LoRa antenna ports
components.description: Separate U.FL connectors attach the GNSS and 915 MHz antennas.

components.name: USB-C interface
components.description: Provides wired power, firmware access and aircraft-side diagnostics.

components.name: TP4056 battery charger
components.description: Charges the single-cell Li-ion battery from USB-C with a constant-current, constant-voltage cycle.

components.name: Battery protection
components.description: The DW01A monitors the cell and controls the 8205A dual MOSFET to disconnect it during overcharge, overdischarge or a short circuit.

components.name: ESP32-WROOM-32E
components.description: Receives telemetry packets, manages local logging, serves the field dashboard and forwards data over USB.

components.name: SX1262 LoRa module
components.description: Receives aircraft telemetry and sends short command bursts back over the 915 MHz link.

components.name: microSD socket
components.description: Stores received packets as CSV or indexed, CRC-protected binary records.

components.name: U.FL antenna connector
components.description: Connects the receiver to its external 915 MHz antenna.

components.name: USB-C receptacle
components.description: Powers the board and carries firmware uploads and the live serial telemetry stream.

components.name: CH340C USB bridge
components.description: Connects the ESP32 UART to USB for programming and live monitoring.

components.name: Automatic upload circuit
components.description: Controls ESP32 EN and IO0 from the USB bridge so firmware can be uploaded without a manual button sequence.

components.name: 3.3 V regulator
components.description: The AMS1117-3.3 converts the incoming 5 V supply for the ESP32, radio and board logic.
